reviews.title: Paying still doesn’t unlock everything
reviews.review: I’m confused- we paid for full access and I’m still seeing rooms locked, parts of the games we can’t play. Even items it looks like we should be able to pay for with our game coins but nothing happens. Not sure if this app is fully functional or a scam for more money.
